text: New research from Meta. (bookmark it) It's on how to fix agents that forget previously made decisions. It's well know that long-horizon agents keep forgetting decisions they already made. creator: Elvis Saravia
text: Another big reason to use combination of frontier models. Chain-of-thought monitoring is treated as a reliable safety layer for agents. This DeepMind-affiliated study shows the layer can be argued out of doing its job. Giving the monitor access to the agent reasoning trace raised approval of harmful actions by 9.5 percent on average, because the scratchpad becomes an extra channel for persuasion.
